{{Top}}
[[File:MasAmedda-BTAHE3.png|thumb|250px|Mas Amedda's lethorns.]]

'''Lethorn''' was the name [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]] applied to the large growths that hung from each side of their head. Both males and females grew lethorns, but males also possessed a secondary pair of horns sprouting from the tops of their heads.

[[Sul Dekkon]] often wore decorative spheres of polished ebonium on the tips of his lethorns.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
